assertions.assertion: The appeal is for denial PR-204
CPT 93247 is long-term continuous electrocardiogram monitoring
The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and presyncope
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has unspecified cardiac arrhythmia
Syncope and presyncope are coded R55
Nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency is coded I34.0
Unspecified cardiac arrhythmia is coded I49.9
The symptoms are intermittent in nature
There is a need to correlate clinical events with underlying rhythm disturbances
Long-term continuous ECG monitoring is indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic causes of collapse
The documented indication directly supports CPT 93247
The service is not covered under the member's benefit plan
